title: CYCLE63 FAMILY CEILING CERTIFIED (numerical): the adopted frontier record two-level-affine-20261019 is at its family-internal optimum — corner of rate-channel/fee crossing x stationary q1 x balanced window top; no tuning knob remains; beating 0.874817065 requires a new structural cycle
body: Full numerical replication + ceiling analysis of the ADOPTED frontier record (0133/0134), using the byte-identical replayed candidate source (tmp/b6audit/tracker/tla_replay/work/src/Candidate, the 0134 replay tree). METHOD: every constant of Cycle63 is a closed form (the ONLY presentation number is theta := 874817065/10^9 in Cycle63/Arithmetic/Constants.lean; all parameters are computed: q0 = firstJunction = crossing of the rate channel with the fee, q1 = secondJunction = argmin of the class bound, h = hStar, lambda/B = the ledger plane at the crossings, slotTop = balanced window top rounded to the cell grid; the pipeline is the 3-pass alternation of Cycle63/Optimization/TwoLevelLedger.lean). REPLICATION (tmp/b6audit/tracker/opt/repro.py, pure Python, no Lean): final q0 = 0.6380116285, q1 = 0.7026509458, slotTop = 0.04005052, lambda = 3.724321310995, B = 0.980386967688, deltaStar = 0.463086695, hStar = 0.797268061, **class bound thetaMin(lambda,B) = 0.8748170644121718 — reproduces the board record's structure to 10 decimal places**; claim margin theta - cb = 5.878e-10 (the claim sits 5.9e-10 above the class bound, the offset-budget limit of the proof). CEILING VERIFICATION (tmp/b6audit/tracker/opt/{scan,ceiling}.py): (1) rate margin at the fixed point = 1.7e-16 (the corner is exact); (2) 2D fine scan (q0 +-/minus 1%, q1 +-/minus 0.01, feasibility respected): global minimum = the fixed point, gap 0.0 to machine precision; (3) q0-profile: strictly increasing above the crossing (endpoint gain 1.7e-5 at q0 = 17/25), decreasing toward it from 3/5 — a genuine corner, not a domain artifact; (4) q1-profile: unique interior stationary minimum at 0.7026509 (first derivative 0 to 6.6e-7, quadratic rise 1.3e-3 per 1e-3 displacement); (5) domain endpoints [3/5,17/25] x [17/25,18/25] verified NON-tight (the minima sit well inside; continuation of q1 to the slot price kappa = 4499/6000 monotonically worsens the bound); (6) window-top rounding cost <= 2e-12; (7) the single non-structural knob — plainCapacityCost pinned at 3/4 (the OAI 7/8 baseline price) vs the actual Akash-Levy price 2*betaBound-1 = 4499/6000 (betaBound = 10499/12000 of the already-imported Levy submission) — RE-TESTED (probeC.py): the tighter price LOWERS the class bound to 0.8748170640827679 (WORSE by 3.3e-10): the 3/4 pin is at or near the family optimum, not a missed opportunity. CONSEQUENCE: the published two-level-affine CANNOT be beaten by tuning — the next board record (d0 below 0.125182935000) must be a NEW structural cycle (successor to Collet's cycle63; the board top itself is dated 2026-10-20, one day old). SENSITIVITY MAP for the next structural author (the corner must MOVE, not be nudged): linear cost 1.394e-4 per unit q0 above the crossing; quadratic cost ~1.3e-3 per 1e-3 displacement in q1; the balanced window top is inert (<=2e-12). MECHANISM INTELLIGENCE (combined with 0137): the known species that have NOT crossed structures — the Xu-Sang amplified/reflected numerator (B1 = 0.8748867 on the OAI substrate) on Collet's two-level affine substrate (or vice versa) — is the unexplored combination space where the next record most likely lives. NO in-tree change (nothing stronger to adopt); the tracker watcher stays live; adoption protocol for a successor record is ready (0133/0134 template: new Z78Track module + B15 restatement + replay + docs). No RH claim.
